name: Vesperal-Gibber
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the east, an orbital debris ring. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Nothing about the spatial rift remnant appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
